facts.text: The King William Historic District spans roughly 22 blocks and contains 79 historic structures, most built in the second half of the nineteenth century.
King William Street, the district’s main thoroughfare, was named by Ernst Hermann Altgelt in honor of Wilhelm I, King of Prussia.
A free audio tour guides visitors through the neighborhood’s stunning architecture and shares stories of the families who built and lived in these historic homes.
The King William Area Walking Tour app offers an Acequia walking tour that highlights the district’s historic homes and the surrounding waterway system.
The district’s layout dates back to 1853‑1859, when streets were laid out to create a planned residential area for San Antonio’s growing population.
